notes.title: The Last Universe ! [Gangs of Space Closing]
notes.content:
Gangs of Space was our child and became the prison of our hopes. Gangs of Space was a stroke of madness that arrived one day, or maybe a night, in Tokyo in the middle of an amusement arcade full of Shmup classics! Gangs of Space it was quite an adventure!

You have understood, it is with great regret that we announce today the upcoming closure of Gangs of Space.

Closing schedule

November 30, 2018: commercial closure (end of the sale of the DLC).May 31, 2019: official servers and support closed.
And after ? Total blackout? We will see, but we can not guarantee anything and in any case, it will be outside of Steam.

Why do we close?

Maybe one day Erhune will have the courage to do a long post-mortem on the dev and the reasons for the end of Gangs of Space, but by then we will try to give you the main reasons:
No money! After all these years of work on Gangs of Space, the launch in Early Access and the reception of tens of thousands of players, we have never been able to pay us, not even a beer or a restaurant … nothing at all! We had made the choice to reinvest everything to self-finance the dev of the game (software, assets, hosting / server, freelance, administration, etc …). How did we manage to stay that long without going crazy? Maybe we already were ?!No founding! But as it was not enough, we tried to find investors to finish GoS in V1, but even with a well advanced game and 70,000 players it was too risky for them.No communication! It’s simple, in 2018 (and also in 2017), to talk about your game in the media, the norm is that you have to pay or that everyone is already talking about you … Totally despairing when you still want to make “different” games that nobody wants to finance.
No more energy! In the end, all this consumed our ultimate energy reserves. We will have tried many things (probably not as good as those who will give us advice) but now it was time to move on.

Commercial closure?

Because we do not want to sell a service that you do not really have time to use at your convenience, we prefer to close the purchase of DLC after this announcement.

This allows us to provide another 6 months of service for the last irreducible who would still like to enjoy a DLC Gangs of Space.

And we promise you, this time “the money of subscribers” who will take a DLC will only serve one thing: to pay us a beer and a good restaurant!

Thanks

After all these years we met many people without whom this project could not have gone so far and we wish to thank:b
First of all, thank you to the family! These relatives who have supported us all these years without understanding our determination to finish GoS. With them no judgment, no advice, but listening, love, and the good dishes of our mothers who comfort so much in times of doubt.Right after, there is YOU, you the 70,000 players! From a few minutes to a few years, you played and participated with determination! Your feedback has been decisive in the evolution of the game. To have made a game that will have you passionate, amused, relaxed, raging, will be our greatest pride forever. Thank you 70,000 times!And thanks to those active members of the community who are especially involved at all levels, wiki, moderation, community pillars, passionate evening streamers, etc … (no names for no jealous, but you will recognize ;-D)-oTo-, our composer who has held all these years and whose work we loved.Thanks to Aganon, Skywilly, Bestio and Seldell, from the websites  Jeuxonline, Game Side Story et Indiemag. If the journalists and the Streamers were all like them, there is no doubt that you will not play at all the same way and many creators would have a greater chance to live from their work and offer you original games!Thanks to the creators of Unity, the transition from Flash to this software has really changed our life and allowed a gigantic qualitative leap for GoS.And finally thank you to all the devs, friends, some streamers, visitors on a show, star (like Richard Garriot or Zun) who have some day participated in their advice, their help, to make Gangs of Space.

Come and sign the big guestbook!

The closing of an MMO is always a special moment, it is the opportunity for the old players to nostalgically recall their best memories. For the occasion, two “Golden Books” are open on our official forum where you are invited to come and tell what GoS was for you, your memories, your anecdotes, even a screenshot?
Guestbook Gangs of Space [english]Guestbook Gangs of Space [french]

MINI FAQ

Why is the game not open source?
This is a good question and we have studied the possibility but it is a big job. There are more legal reasons because we would not have the right to open some code blocks. In short, it is very complex.
Why was the game not sold? Users have value no?
An MMO that is not finished is very complicated to sell, it’s not like a solo game. It will be necessary to put hands in the code, take care of the servers, etc. So unless you have a huge community or a big marketing buzz around the project, nobody wants to get wet.
All hope is lost forever?
It is almost certain that neither Erhune nor Grouroux will ever work on Gangs of Space again. On the other hand if one day a serious team wishes to work on Gangs of Space and shows us that it has the capacity, one will study it with the greatest care.

notes.title: 8 new Skins to collect
notes.content:
With the start of the Sixo Vaporis galaxy, we have added 8 new skins. All these skins are linked to special codes that you can activate in your account management area. The Skin code hunt is open!

Lord British & Lord Chaos

These two skins are a tribute to Ultima Online and two of its creators: Richard Garriott and Starr Long. They refer to the two characters they incarnated: Lord British and Lord Blackthorn. So if you meet one of these ships, maybe you have the chance to meet a legend (Richard Garriott is also an astronaut)!
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/0/0edae74270dd8a1cb69c431a062f6463b02d71dc.jpg

How to get this skin: No idea, but they have codes and can do what they want ;-)

Drifting Lands

Drifting Lands is a SHMUP Hack’n Slash graphically superb and with very interesting game mechanics (the auto-warp is inspired by one of their system). And to make this skin,  Alkemi Games has agreed to share with us the sources of the Marauder with which we made an original “module”!
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/f/f272ddbf68e9380275f52e69108da088207c69da.jpg

How to get this skin: I have heard that there will be code available in the Steam forums of the game…

monsieursapin

monsieursapin is a very nice french Streamer who loves to discover games in all styles to his joyful community. It was very fun to make this skin “sapin” which was also the name of the first enemies that we had in the first prototype of Gangs of Space!
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/6/65b6d1e767ccab8bff9d591ead6e9e62f0ed7cfe.jpg

How to get this skin: Watch it live on his channel https://www.twitch.tv/monsieursapin

Bestio

Bestio is THE streamer of Shmup in France. Big fan of bullets and Hack’n Slash, he fell very early on Gangs of Space and followed us all these years. This skin is like a big thank you to him for his passion of games!
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/5/58f2e3f2d2b2f66767cb589407059fafb211390f.jpg

How to get this skin: Watch it live on his channel https://www.twitch.tv/bestiyo

IndieMag

Indiemag is a french website devoted to independent games. He has always followed the evolution of Gangs of Space. Seldell, one of the creators of the site, is a fervent defender of independent games for years.
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/f/f186f6a32767f01878d0283ab78a70e93c390edc.jpg

How to get this skin: By going to see this page maybe

Game Side Story

GameSideStory is the indie press of the video games. For years they have been talking about it with passion and without pressure. This crazy team has already tested over 2013 games, so that they all have a chance to exist. And that, it deserves a special skin!
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/3/335fce33555765b2a72e575a86a137faa5cbbdfc.jpg

How to get this skin: You need to work on GSS editing, ask Skywilly!

Isaac

The Binding of Isaac by Edmund McMillen is one of our cult games that has greatly influenced the latest version of Gangs of Space. But all the work of McMillen is incredible and we wanted to pay tribute to him with this very weird skin.
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/6/63611944bd4522efddd5da091dfc90ed9565b957.jpg

How to get this skin: no idea, no answer from him for now. :’(

How to use codes?

Log in to your account management and enter the code at this location:

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/e/eeedd4d3377a357ab7faad480521aec0639ff0d7.png

notes.title: Death to the permadeath
notes.content:
Death to the permadeath!

Gangs of Space has been designed from the beginning to be a permadeath game (even before we introduced the “roguelite” elements like subsystems; our inspiration is taken mostly from old arcade games).

Even though we - and many players - like it this way, it is true that losing a ship can be a demoralizing experience for a new player. So today, we’re introducing a permadeath protection designed to help beginners without changing the fundamental high-level game for experienced players.

From now on, newly built ships will be equipped by default with a new passive item: the Auto-Warp. This item warps you back automatically to the Motherbase when you would have taken a fatal hit, but it comes with a few drawbacks:

since it is a passive item, you cannot equip another item that would have given you nice passive bonuses;
it lowers all Sector Points (SP) and Credit gains by 25%;
it prevents you from warping to T5 or T6 systems.

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/f/f880b9c1f11cd497ff13bdaca4c86e10d474e8e7.png

You can remove this item at any time (and we encourage experienced players to do so!), but it will be destroyed in the process.

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/5/5c601129d589bad5daf39f589ce82e53851ed6a9.png

New base skins

To add some visual variety, all ships are now created randomly with one out of 3 base colors.

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/original/2X/4/4d74d7a05e028ea7ea1e0b1874b242ba8b180f83.png

Of course you can still customize your ship at any time (for free) in the Skin Shop.

10 new music tracks!

Alex, the composer of the soundtrack of Gangs of Space, has been touched by all your positive feedback about his compositions. So he has graced us with 10 more tracks, which triples the amount of music we now have in the game!

You can discover these new tracks everywhere, from an alternative Motherbase ambiance to different music for all 6 tiers, and even some music on the death screen! (another good reason to un-equip your Auto-Warp!)

Patch 0.31.11

As usual, all the details of the patch are available in the changelog.

A wiki full of treasures

Thanks to a growing team of motivated players, the Gangs of Space Wiki is now full of useful information:

wiki.gangsofspace.com

Items, ships, subsystems, drops, enemies… all there, ready for your eyes!

There is still a lot of translation work though, so if you speak another language like Spanish, Russian, Chinese, German, Portuguese… then join the Wiki team on Discord! You will be more than welcome!

A new Conquest: Cinquo Vaporis Galaxy

The Empire has started the construction of a new Motherbase in Cinquo Vaporis Galaxy. Enemy forces have been evaluted to about 17,000,000. Get ready for the cleaning, and maybe the Empire will reward the most valorous of you!

Summary of the previous Conquest

Shark Investor Pack
The Imperial Bank has computed dividends for the conquest of Quatro Vaporis Galaxy. Each Share will be awarded dividends of 168 Credits, for a total of 8,400 Credits for the 50 Shares of the Shark Investor Pack.

Ladders
Congratulations to all players that exterminated the Pirnat faction in  1 week, 12 hours, 18 minutes, and 7 seconds.

The players and Gangs that will receive Imperial awards for this Conquest are:
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/7/7b3292bb2d70fdb5c4a83fbd6ebb4c783e8f5da5_1_690x281.png

Souvenir
A last glimpse of Quatro Vaporis Galaxy accompanied by a group picture of the winning Gang:

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/6/6c0c38c8c70adc14f40dcd7fcb82989c071bfe38_1_690x421.png

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/c/ce6e2a8f5caf847fe3b2f4985f645bf2caba3d01_1_682x800.png

notes.title: Update v0.31.11 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.31.11

Tiesday, September 19, 2017

FEATURES

Added permadeath protection as a passive item Auto-Warp that is equipped by default on all ships.

While the Auto-Warp is equipped, any fatal damage will warp you back to the Motherbase instead.
The Auto-Warp prevents you from equipping a passive item, it gives -25% to Sector Points & Credits during sector conquest, and prevents you from warping to T5 or T6 systems.
Unequipping the Auto-Warp destroys it permanently for this ship.


10 new music tracks!
New ships are now built with a random skin out of the 3 basic skins.

SMALL CHANGES

Added an option (enabled by default) to lock the mouse cursor to the game window.
Display MAINTENANCE IN PROGRESS instead of RESTRICTED TO ADMINS when trying to connect to the server during maintenance.

BALANCE

Rounding all Credit gains up, so you always get at least 1 Credit for conquering a zone.

BUG FIXES

Fixed the save issue that affected some ships since previous version.
Removed the confirmation message when quitting by Alt+F4 or clicking the red [x], since it caused the network library to disconnect.

notes.title: Update v0.31.10 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.31.10

Friday, September 15, 2017

FEATURES

Added a setting to make the mouse cursor bigger (4 different sizes).
Added a facultative key binding to open/close all Warehouses at once.
The name of drops that are reserved for other players is now darkened to differentiate them better in a big pile of loot.

SMALL CHANGES

Added a confirmation window when quitting the game.
The Skin Shop is no longer opened automatically after building a new ship.
Do not display a conquest time estimate during the first 10% of the Conquest.
The ladder reward tooltip is now scaled up for players playing in high resolutions.
Made Send to Warehouse and Convert to DNA dropzones a bit more visible.
Improved errors messages in many different situations when you cannot connect to the game.
You can now cancel modal windows with the Escape key.
Made the description of some controls more explicit.

BALANCE

The +X% item drop stat is now applied properly.
The Energy recharge stat of all passive items (Dedicator, Duocator and Tricator) has been lowered at max level, to prevent some cases of infinite abilities.

BUG FIXES

Fixed the progress of unlocks sometimes getting reset without any reason.

Note that there is still a visual bug that make it so progress seems to be lost in some situations, but selecting a new ship of the type required by the unlock will refresh the counter to the right value.


Fixed the close button for the redesigned Galaxy Conquest window.
Fixed the danger tooltip on the Greed bar.
Fixed typos on the ladder tooltips.

notes.title: END OF THIRD CONQUEST
notes.content:
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/3/30e7c6832672eb68b8d4fddd93718de6b7442fa2_1_690x281.png

Galaxy Tertio Vaporis has been conquered in 10 days, 11 hours, 1 minute et 6 seconds!

On the ladder side:


DJOKKATAJA wins the TOP GRIND with a very impressive score of 1,174,894 SP. A new record! But Zed is just behind… on purpose, maybe?
Because on the TOP SKILL side, Zed improves his previous best score, and reaches almost 33K SP/h! Jhirin and kragnir beat their previous records too, but it wasn’t enough this time.
On the TOP GANG, 8-bit Warriors get their first victory, pushed by their leader and their very active members. They almost reach the previous record set by Meta in the previous Galaxy!


SUMMARY

During this Conquest, we have banned 15 accounts for cheating. We remind everyone that modifying the game client or the game memory is forbidden by our Terms of Service. It is a question of common sense: let’s keep a pleasant environment for everyone to play and compete in!

The wiki.gangsofspace.com grows bigger and bigger, with new info coming every day, and translations in French and Russian starting to pop in. If you can write decent Chinese, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, or any other language spoken by a part of the Gangs of Space community, why not contribute to the effort?

On the Steam side, we celebrate today our 1 month release anniversary! With 10 versions published during this period, almost one every 3 days! On your side, you’ve left 216 evaluations, 78% positive. Thanks a lot!

RECENT PATCHES

We are pushing a lot of small updates these days, of course to fix problems that have been reported to you, but also to improve the way we convey information in the game. We’re very happy to see that the community has stepped in to help newbies understand the game better, but we need to do our part, and make the game more easily understood!

We have also worked a ton on “invisible” tasks in the background, including server optimization. If you haven’t tried v0.31.8, you’ll be surprised by how much pleasant the game is to play without all these pesky server lags that plagued us since the release!

Today, along with the new Conquest we are releasing v0.31.9 that revamps the ingame ladder interface, and a lot of quality-of-life improvements. Check out all the details in the changelog!

SHARK INVESTOR PACK

How many dividends will our Shark Investors earn for the conquest of Tertio Vaporis?

The latest data from the Imperial Bank shows that each Share will receive a dividend of 312 Credits, which means 15,600 Credits for the 50 Shares of the Pack Shark Investor.

SOUVENIR

Thanks to kragnir for remembering to take a end-of-galaxy souvenir picture, since we couldn’t be there on time to take one. Bye bye Tertio Vaporis!

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/6/6fc370c9661ecc078cb70258cd7fc6348cc64140_1_690x580.png

Because on the TOP SKILL side, Zed improves his previous best score, and reaches almost 33K SP/h! Jhirin and kragnir beat their previous records too, but it wasn’t enough this time.
On the TOP GANG, 8-bit Warriors get their first victory, pushed by their leader and their very active members. They almost reach the previous record set by Meta in the previous Galaxy!


SUMMARY

During this Conquest, we have banned 15 accounts for cheating. We remind everyone that modifying the game client or the game memory is forbidden by our Terms of Service. It is a question of common sense: let’s keep a pleasant environment for everyone to play and compete in!

The wiki.gangsofspace.com grows bigger and bigger, with new info coming every day, and translations in French and Russian starting to pop in. If you can write decent Chinese, Polish, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, or any other language spoken by a part of the Gangs of Space community, why not contribute to the effort?

On the Steam side, we celebrate today our 1 month release anniversary! With 10 versions published during this period, almost one every 3 days! On your side, you’ve left 216 evaluations, 78% positive. Thanks a lot!

RECENT PATCHES

We are pushing a lot of small updates these days, of course to fix problems that have been reported to you, but also to improve the way we convey information in the game. We’re very happy to see that the community has stepped in to help newbies understand the game better, but we need to do our part, and make the game more easily understood!

We have also worked a ton on “invisible” tasks in the background, including server optimization. If you haven’t tried v0.31.8, you’ll be surprised by how much pleasant the game is to play without all these pesky server lags that plagued us since the release!

Today, along with the new Conquest we are releasing v0.31.9 that revamps the ingame ladder interface, and a lot of quality-of-life improvements. Check out all the details in the changelog!

SHARK INVESTOR PACK

How many dividends will our Shark Investors earn for the conquest of Tertio Vaporis?

The latest data from the Imperial Bank shows that each Share will receive a dividend of 312 Credits, which means 15,600 Credits for the 50 Shares of the Pack Shark Investor.

SOUVENIR

Thanks to kragnir for remembering to take a end-of-galaxy souvenir picture, since we couldn’t be there on time to take one. Bye bye Tertio Vaporis!

notes.title: Update v0.31.9 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.31.9

Sunday, September 10, 2017

FEATURES

The Empire News Network is now the Galaxy Conquest window:

All 3 ladders are now displayed in the game: Grind Ladder, Skill Ladder and Gangs Ladder.
The estimated time until the conquest ends is now computed and displayed in the game and on gangsofspace.com!
A tooltip has been added to show the ladder rewards.

Please note that the skill ladder still lacks its Skin reward, it will be added in an upcoming version.


Small tooltips have been added to indicate what each ladder is about, and how to get SP and CP.
The progress tooltip when docking to the Motherbase has been reworked to be more readable.


The “Send to motherbase” and “Convert to DNA” drop zones have been moved far away so you don’t mistake one for another.

You can now also add a key binding to these actions.


Added tooltips:

On the danger bar in the top right.
On the warp button in the bottom right.



BALANCE

Fixed the bonus SP for being top Gang in a sector:

Before v0.31.8, the sector conquest notification had been indicating a bonus SP of 50% / 25% / 10%, but it was actually never given to players due to a bug.
Since we didn’t want to disrupt the conquest of Galaxy Tertio Vaporis, we had disabled this bonus in the tooltip in v0.31.8.
With the start of Galaxy Quadro Vaporis in v0.31.9, we now have fixed the issue and set the bonus SP to 30% / 20% / 10%.


Changed the bonus CP for being top Gang in a system from 35% / 20% / 10% to 30% / 20% / 10%.

BUG FIXES

Hangar ships can no longer be scrolled with the mousewheel when there is no scrollbar.
The “Get more storage…” button no longer scrolls along with the warehouse buttons.
Move the Gang window to the left when deploying the invite panel in a position where it would be normally hidden.
Fixed incorrectly surviving with 1 structure in some situations.
Fix showing the wrong level after closing & re-opening the inventory window.
Switching equipment with the 1 ~ 5 keys now also works with the inventory closed.
Fix Ctrl-clicking a ship item to send it to an open warehouse.

Thursday, September 7, 2017

PERFORMANCE

Significantly reduced the number of server lags.

BALANCE

notes.title: End of second conquest + patch v0.31.5
notes.content:
https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/2X/a/a9570f63c70de07fca805ed590582f2d84de49cf_1_690x281.png

Congratulations all, you have eliminated 15,000,000 Pirnats points in 7 days, 6 hours, 13 minutes and 30 seconds!

OVER THE TOP

Without further ado, let’s examine the top of the ladders:


On the TOP GRIND, Zed sets a new record with 576k SP. Congratulations!
On the TOP SKILL we also find Zed. It’s the proof of a great talent! With 27k SP/h, he will be quite the challenger to beat. Will kragnir, Jhirin or Brotspinne, who also show promising results, manage to reach his level?
The TOP GANG, has been swamped by Meta who entered the competition and left no hope to the other Gangs. With 1,484,800 CP, they have annihilated almost 10% of the Pirnat forces all by themselves! Our previous champions Esports drop to #4, while the 8-Bit Warriors show great promises for the future conquests!



SUMMARY

We have seen a few cheaters emerge during this Conquest. It is unfortunate to have to spend our very limited time and efforts to prevent them ruining the gaming experience of the community. We want to use the opportunity to remind everyone that third-party hacking tools and client modifications are against our Terms of Use, and punishable by account ban. If you have doubt about what’s allowed or not, you can write us privately on contact@gangsofspace.com and we’ll clarify the situation.

On a more positive note, thanks to the efforts of the Discord community, the work on the Gangs of Space wiki. Come have a look, and maybe help the writing or translation efforts if you can!

And finally on the Steam side, we have reached 180 evaluations. Your honest opinion is always appreciated, and can help other players to better understand Gangs of Space!

PATCH 0.31.5

Here are the main changes of the new version, along with the start of the new Conquest:


Collected Credits and blue DNA strands have been re-designed visually to be more readable.
Private messages have been re-enabled: use /w  
Some balancing to the Astrolax class:

The energy cost of S-Link has been adjusted to the one of Y-Link.
Structure Wave radius has been greatly increased.
The Stolers armaments now also provide a significant passive damage bonus.


Kamikazes Hunter spawns have been limited in T4 and T5 systems.
Many bug fixes and various small improvements.


For all gritty details, you can read the changelog on the forum.

SHARK INVESTOR PACK

“End of Conquest” means “dividends time” for Shark Investor Pack owners!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

The Imperial Bank has computed the total cost of the conquest of Secundo Vaporis Galaxy, and determined that each Share will receive a dividend of 369 Credits, meaning 18,450 Credits for the 50 Shares of the Shark Investor Pack. Thank you for financing our glorious Conquests!

Also note that the history of your dividends is now visible on your account management page on this very website!

SOUVENIR

A few shots of the last moments in Secundo Vaporis Galaxy. See you in Tertio Vaporis!

notes.title: End of the first conquest & patch v0.31.4
notes.content:
Congratulations to all players and all Gangs: you conquered the Primor Vaporis Galaxy in 8 days, 7 hours, 36 minutes and 28 seconds!

OVER THE TOP

Let’s have a look at the final ladders:

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/697df3950de60ac3bdd5bc2d907007a0d2b09cc2_1_690x287.png


On the TOP GRIND, we have a new Commander imposing his style: Touch Me wins by a fair margin his title and his champion skin, with over 400,000 SP. Congratulations!
On the TOP GANG ! Esports get their first victory thank to a flawless teamwork. We say on the game Discord channel that this ladder was very fierce, and not only for the top 10 spots! Congratulations to everyone!
And finally, for the new TOP SKILL, Roix shows us that experience acquired over years of alpha versions still make him the top dog. With a peak of over 25k SP/h, he dominates the ladder by far.



With this first conquest on Steam Early Access, many new players have joined the ranks of the Empire and are learning all the mechanics of the game very fast. Next Galaxy should turn out very competitive indeed!

STATE OF THE GAME

It is for us a great emotion to see the servers so full of players all the time, for the first time of the existence of the game. From the bottom of our heart: THANK YOU! We’ve spent years working on this game, and seeing so many people enjoying it for real is giving us the energy to move forward with the game.


Speaking of moving forward, some words about our next steps.We are globally satisfied with the state of the game, but we have seen how hard it is for many players to understand the game, or some parts of it. We plan on putting a lot of efforts over the next weeks to improve the situation, and have already started to work on a FAQ here: https://www.gangsofspace.com/faq


The Discord community  has also started to work on a wiki to give more details, with specific numbers for every aspect of the game. Join them if you want to help the effort!


Over the past week, we have been having between 150 and 250 players online almost all the time. This makes the universe alive, with always something to do. We had to fix a few things on the server side to handle the load. This invisible effort continues every day, and will probably continue all over the duration of the Early Access. Thank you for bearing with the small bugs and slowdowns, and be assured that fixing that is always at high priority on our list.


On the Steam side, we’ve passed 100+ evaluations with 81% positive. Don’t hesitate to add your voice to the crowd, that’s how more players will know about Gangs of Space!

PATCH 0.31.4

We have deployed v0.31.4 along with the opening of the new Galaxy.


The main visible change of this version is the complete overhaul of Credit gains. We changed the Conquest rewards in v0.30 a few months ago, and we were a bit too conservative on the gains of the new system. Now that we have more data to back up our design, we have increased the Credit rewards of conquest quite significantly, especially in lower Tiers.


We also added a feature where every time you unlock a new ship, you will gain the amount Credits necessary to build this ship. For example, when you unlock the Gemeter DX, you will now receive 10,000 Credits. We have applied this retroactively to all already unlocked ships.


For more details, you can read the complete changelog.

SHARE DIVIDENDS

If you bought a Shark Investor Pack, now is the time to figure out how many Credits your Shares have produced!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/670961/Gangs_of_Space__Shark_Investor_Pack/

After a complex calculation by the Imperial Bank, we have determined that every Share will receive a dividend of 202 Credits.


But as a celebration of the first Conquest, and because the lowered Credit gains have impacted the amount of total Credits spent, we have decided to double this amount. You have thus received 404 Credits per Share, which means 20,200 Credits for a 50 Share Investor Pack.


Stay tuned for the next Conquest. Hopefully, with the increase of Credit gains brought by the new patch, dividends might rise even further!

A MMO IS A COMMUNITY BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE

Join the Discord or the forum. We are answering all your questions, and listening to all your suggestions for the future of the game!

SOUVENIR

A last memory of Primor Vaporis before leaving for a new adventure:

https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/a8abbb9425140679c4e89020a4d9f403a8fa0826_1_690x388.jpg


https://forum.gangsofspace.com/uploads/default/optimized/1X/109e01d4c3fd9cc60eb097cccc030ec28e10fd31_1_690x388.jpg

notes.title: Update v0.31.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.31.4

Saturday, August 19, 2017

BALANCE

Credit rewards for conquest have been significantly increased for all Tiers.
We are now giving Credit rewards when unlocking new ships, of the build cost of the ship. This will ensure you can always immediatly build a ship you just unlocked.

For example, unlocking the Gemeter SX will give you 1,000 Credits, and unlocking the Gemeter DX will give you 10,000 Credits.

NOTE: These rewards will be applied retroactively to already unlocked ships.


Overall quality for rare drops has been increased in T6 systems.

BUG FIXES

Fixed a serious bug where Credits were not given when purchasing Packs. This affected very few customers, and we are in the process of fixing their accounts and contacting them individually.
Items are no longer destructible after 10s, but properly after 30s.
Disabled the foreword from the developers on first launch, which seemed to cause blocking issues to some players.
Removed the ability to bind keys Hide all interfaces and Hide interfaces partially, which caused issues when bound to left click for example.
Fixed the LinkSys abilities being properly removed from their target when the emitting Astrolax dies.
Fixed the computation of remaining SP on the sector description and sector tooltip. The number displayed was only approximately correct, now it should be exact.
(Hopefully) fixed the issue of the navigation UI getting cluttered with Conquered systems.
Fixed a typo in the description of RaimBlock.


All the latest patch notes are readable in this thread.

notes.title: Update v0.31 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.31

Thursday, August 10, 2017

MAIN FEATURES

Gangs of Space is now available on Steam Early Access!

With a brand new title screen.
3 new skins & titles that can be purchased in Early Access Packs.
Foreword from the developers on first launch of the client.


Changes to the conquest system:

Conquering each zone now gives Credits instead of DNA (or Greed).
Conquest is now the sole source of Credits (no more Credits on Greed level up or ship destruction).
Greed level now affects both conquest speed AND the number of Credits & Sector Points earned.


New tutorial system that forces you to do a few specific actions when you start the game.

These tutorial tooltips can be completely disabled in the Settings.
Tips about the game are also shown on warp screens.


Redesigned Gang interface:

Gangs can be created from within the game.
Gang members now have ranks: Owner, Admin, or Member.
New invitation UI (both for inviter & invitee).
Owner can now leave their Gang, and ownership will be automatically transfered to next highest ranking member.



BALANCE

Player resistance are now capped to 75% (down from 90%).
When you loose a Greed level, you do not start at the beginning of the previous level, but at the end of it. The Greed depleting rate has been slightly increased. Overall, higher Greed levels are easier to obtain & sustain.
Boss no longer spawn before T4.
Common items drop less in high tier systems.
The leveling from level 1 to level 10 is now smoother.
Enemy group compositions have been re-balanced.
Small zones now give a bit more Credits and Sector Points.
Conquest scores now expire faster if you leave a Sector untouched (3 minutes, down from 1 hour).

SMALL CHANGES

Warehouses can be renamed and re-ordered.
Added an alternative basic skin for Gemeters and Astrolaxes, available to everyone.
Skins no longer cost Credits to apply to your ships.
Conquered maps now close after 5 minutes (down from 10 minutes).
The Objective Tracker is now a little more readable.
Gates are now oriented properly in the Motherbase.
Tooltips are much more readable across the board.
Multiple tiers can be deployed at the same time in the Navigation window.
When you reach a certain power level, the game will suggest T4 (normal), T5 (hard) and T6 (very hard) systems instead of just suggesting T4.
Added trophy titles from the previous conquests.
Updated the player overlay to make the name & bars more readable.
Updated the enemy gauge to make it more readable.
Neutral Sectors (= conquered by the Empire) are now shown in blue, the same as Sectors conquered by a Gang.
You can see other players’ item hauls.
You can no longer move, jettison or destroy items during the Warp countdown.
Support for multiple Motherbases (in case of high server load).

BUG FIXES

Fixed the client freezing when joining some broken systems.
Removed hidden Greed leveling in T1~T3 maps.
Fixed the position where popup list open (ex: ship selector in Achievement Codex, resolution list in Settings…).
Fixed many broken sprites all over the UI.
Boss lifebars no longer block on the first bar.
Player & enemies overlays stay in proper position when changing resolution.
The client log should no longer grow to multiple GB.
Fixed a slight jerkiness on the damage numbers’ movement.
Conquest gauge no longer overlaps with the leveling choice window.
Typing 1~5 in chat will no longer swap items when chatting with the Ship window open.
Prevent multiple cases of disconnect with the message “ITEM OPERATION CANCELLED”.
